WITH transaction_customer AS (
  SELECT 
    ft.transaction_id,
    COALESCE(ft.transaction_amount, 0) as transaction_amount,
    c.state_county_province
  FROM Financial_Transactions ft
  JOIN Invoices i ON ft.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
  JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
),
state_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    state_county_province,
    SUM(transaction_amount) as state_total
  FROM transaction_customer
  GROUP BY state_county_province
),
grand_total_value AS (
  SELECT SUM(state_total) as grand_total FROM state_totals
),
state_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    state_county_province,
    state_total,
    state_total / (SELECT grand_total FROM grand_total_value) as share
  FROM state_totals
),
average_share_value AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM state_shares
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    state_county_province,
    state_total,
    share
  FROM state_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share_value)
)
SELECT 
  SUM(state_total) as combined_total,
  AVG(share) as avg_share_of_above_average_states,
  AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share_value)) as avg_excess_above_average
FROM above_average
